description: A young woman with blonde hair, cat ears, and facial markings stands beside a red rural mailbox, holding a cardboard package with both hands. She has a slight smile while looking down at the box, set against a suburban backdrop with houses, trees, and warm golden sunlight.
title: Catgirl at the Mailbox
prompt: A young woman with short messy blonde hair, prominent cat ears, and orange facial markings stands in a suburban front yard at sunset, wearing a beige plaid button-up shirt and cargo pants. She holds a plain cardboard box with both hands while standing next to a classic red metal mailbox with its flag up. She has a gentle smile and is looking down at the package. Warm golden hour sunlight creates a strong backlight and lens flare, soft bokeh background with green lawn, trees, and a house visible. Photorealistic, natural lighting, cinematic composition.
